name: Canada T2 Corporation Income Tax Return

definition.instructions: Prepare or reconcile the monetary workpaper for the CRA T2 Corporation Income Tax Return for 2025 and later tax years. Every non-formula input field may optionally use organization- and ledger-specific account mappings; unmapped lines remain available for manual entry, while mapped values replace manual entry. Map all income-statement accounts to book net income, enter or map reviewed Schedule 1 adjustments and amounts supported by the applicable T2 schedules, and compare the resulting T2 lines with the filed return. This template does not determine eligibility, replace the T2 schedules or GIFI, file a return, or calculate every tax rate. The T2 generally serves as the federal, provincial, and territorial return, but Quebec and Alberta require separate provincial corporate returns. Review the current CRA form and T4012 guide before filing.

validations.label: Taxable income cannot be negative
validations.description: T2 line 360 uses a zero floor before applicable line 355 additions and should not be negative.

validations.label: Total tax includes federal tax
validations.description: Line 770 should not be less than the total federal tax workpaper amount; a negative Schedule 5 result belongs on line 812 rather than line 760.

validations.label: Refund and balance owing are mutually exclusive
validations.description: The T2 summary can result in a refund or a balance owing, but not both.
